Privacy Policy

Last updated: 17 November 2026

This policy explains what personal data Relay collects, why, how long we keep it and what your rights are. It describes what the app actually does today. The controller is Hardouch Anas, who runs Relay from Morocco.

Short version: we collect what's needed to run a chat app, we don't sell data, there are no ads and no analytics or tracking cookies, and you can download or delete your data yourself in Settings.

2. Legal bases

  • Contract: to provide the service you signed up for (account, messages, calls, settings).
  • Legitimate interests: security, preventing abuse and moderation.
  • Consent: optional features such as push notifications, location sharing and microphone or camera access. You can withdraw it at any time.
  • Legal obligation: when the law requires us to keep or hand over data.

3. Who can see your data

  • People you chat with see what you send them and your profile.
  • The site owner can review non-secret conversations, for example to investigate a report. Every such access is written to an audit log. Other admins can manage accounts but can't read messages. Nobody, including the owner, can read secret chats.
  • Service providers that process data for us:
    • Cloudflare, Inc.: hosting, database, storage, calls relay (TURN) and network security. Data may be processed in data centers outside Morocco, including the EU and the United States.
    • Cloudflare Workers AI: only when you press “Transcribe” or “Translate” on a message; that text or voice note is processed to produce the result.
    • Browser push services (Google, Apple, Mozilla, Microsoft, depending on your browser): deliver notifications if you turn them on. Notifications carry no message content: the push service only learns that something happened, and your device shows a generic “New message”.
  • Chill (music, videos, radio, podcasts, trivia) searches YouTube, Apple iTunes, Radio Browser, Open Trivia DB and JokeAPI through our server, so those services don't see who you are. When you play a YouTube video, it loads from youtube-nocookie.com and Google's privacy policy applies.

We never sell your data and we don't show ads.

4. International transfers

Because Relay runs on Cloudflare's global network, your data may be stored or processed outside your country. Cloudflare offers standard contractual clauses and the EU–US Data Privacy Framework for these transfers.

5. Security

Passwords are salted and hashed, sign-in tokens are stored only as hashes, all traffic uses HTTPS, and strict security headers protect every page. Secret chats use end-to-end encryption. No system is perfectly secure; if a breach affects you, we'll tell you and the authorities as the law requires.

6. Your rights

You can:

  • Access and take your data: Settings → Your data → Export (a JSON file).
  • Correct it: edit your profile in Settings.
  • Delete it: Settings → Your data → Delete account. Your account, profile, sessions and the messages you sent are deleted straight away. One-to-one chats are deleted for both people; messages others sent in groups stay with the group.
  • Object or restrict, and withdraw consent for optional features at any time.
  • Complain to a data-protection authority. In Morocco that's the CNDP (Commission Nationale de contrôle de la protection des Données à caractère Personnel). If you live in the EU or UK, you can also contact your local authority.

For anything you can't do in the app, contact us: github.com/Anas2103/Relay/issues.

7. Children

Relay is not for anyone under 16. We check age at sign-up. If we learn that someone under 16 has an account, we close it and delete its data.

8. Cookies and local storage

Relay uses one sign-in cookie and stores some preferences on your device. No tracking or advertising cookies. Details: Cookies & storage.

9. Changes

When this policy changes in a way that matters, Relay will ask you to read and accept it again. The date at the top shows the latest version.
